typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		MBR_ID as string,
		MBR_LASTNAME as string,
		MBR_FIRSTNAME as string,
		MBR_DOB as string,
		MBR_ADDR_LINE_1 as string,
		MBR_CITY as string,
		MBR_POSTALCODE as string,
		MBR_COUNTY as string,
		MBR_LOB_DESC as string,
		EXCLUSION_CATEGORY as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT MBR_ID, MBR_LASTNAME, MBR_FIRSTNAME, MBR_DOB, MBR_ADDR_LINE_1, MBR_CITY, MBR_POSTALCODE	,MBR_COUNTY, MBR_LOB_DESC, EXCLUSION_CATEGORY  FROM  Extract.WNY_EXCLUSION_POPULATION_REPORT  ORDER BY MBR_ID',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of MBR_LASTNAME} = toString(MBR_LASTNAME),
		{Copy of MBR_FIRSTNAME} = toString(MBR_FIRSTNAME),
		{Copy of MBR_CITY} = toString(MBR_CITY),
		{Copy of MBR_LOB_DESC} = toString(MBR_LOB_DESC),
		{Copy of MBR_COUNTY} = toString(MBR_COUNTY),
		{Copy of MBR_POSTALCODE} = toString(MBR_POSTALCODE),
		{Copy of MBR_DOB} = toString(MBR_DOB),
		{Copy of MBR_ADDR_LINE_1} = toString(MBR_ADDR_LINE_1),
		{Copy of MBR_ID} = toString(MBR_ID),
		{Copy of EXCLUSION_CATEGORY} = toString(EXCLUSION_CATEGORY)) ~> DataConversion
